name: Current Route Block
description: Provides a block that displays information about the current route on a page.
project_description: This Drupal module provides a single block plugin that displays information about the current route on the page where it is placed. It is designed to help backend developers and site administrators identify the active route, its parameters, path pattern, and allowed HTTP methods, making it easier to understand or modify the workflow that uses that route. The block is added through the standard block layout; there is no dedicated settings form, no permissions, and no configuration schema shipped by the module. It renders the route name, the upcast route parameters (JSON-encoded), the route path pattern, and the route methods as a themed item list, and it disables its own cache so the information is always current for the page being viewed.
